failure_mechanism: 40ms original/background crossfades were applied at every individual speech window boundary. When adjacent windows touch, they belong to a continuous replacement region; bringing source back at that join or true EOF can reintroduce original narration.
fix: Round speech boundaries to samples; suppress original-source fades at shared starts/ends and true EOF; preserve isolated internal-boundary fades.
actual_assertions: Saved mixed WAV every sample <0.151 and >0.099
verification_boundary: This regression executes the production mixer and checks actual saved PCM. It stubs media alignment/encoding to copy the fixture WAV; it is not an AAC encoder test or proof of source separation quality. Business delivery separately uses actual MP4/full/endpoints review.
limits: Only touching windows and true EOF proven by this fixture.
Existing fades at isolated boundaries remain; retained source speech outside replacement windows still needs actual review.
No TTS-provider root cause, language accuracy or visual acceptance inferred.
